text:
Joe_Cust: Hi team — launching a small pilot next week, need BYO keys + HSM. Quick Qs:
1) perf impact (latency p50/p95) for envelope encryption with external KMS?
2) rotation: can we do daily ephemeral DEK rotation?
3) network: what egress/IPs/ports needed for CloudHSM proxy?
4) pricing: per-call or per-connection for Dedicated? Need SOW/quote by Wed.

sarah_ae: Thanks Joe — looping in @raj_se and @micah_engops to handle tech + pricing.

raj_se: Short answers:
1) Hosted KMS-proxy adds ~5–8ms median, ~20–40ms p95 for 2048 RSA unwrap; AES-GCM DEK unwrap is <3ms on our path.
2) Daily DEK rotation supported; recommend rolling window with overlap to avoid invalidation.
3) Network: outbound TLS to our control plane + to HSM: I'll paste exact ports in a sec.

micah_engops: Correcting ports — for BYO-HSM via proxy you need:
- Allow outbound to 54.23.11.99:443 (control plane)
- Ephemeral TLS to HSM over 15001 and 15002 for replication
- If using on-prem connector: open 4500/udp for heartbeat
We also support VPC peering (no NAT) for lower latency.

raj_se: Pricing summary (high level): Hosted + BYO-KMS = hosted usage fees + proxy egress per unwrap call. Dedicated HSM pool = monthly commit (reserves GPU/HSM capacity) + per-request uplift only if you exceed commit. Share expected QPS & key-ops and I can give ballparks.

Joe_Cust: QPS ~ 50 warm requests/sec, key ops ~ 200 unwraps/min. Need estimate for both Hosted-proxy and Dedicated.

micah_engops: Ballpark:
- Hosted-proxy: add ~$0.002 per unwrap call + standard token usage
- Dedicated commit (for ~50 QPS): ~$12,000/mo, includes up to 500k unwraps/mo; overflow $0.0009/unwrap
(again, rough — will refine with exact QPS distribution)

Joe_Cust: Legal asks: do you store customer CMKs? Customer must retain sole custody. Also need vendor security questionnaire answered — can you assign an owner?

legal_bot: Assigned: @sarah_ae will be owner. We'll push our vendor-sec pack link to this thread.

sarah_ae: I'll send SOW template and a short checklist by EOD. Need network contact and SOC2 contact from your side.

raj_se: Example proxy config (ops copy):
```yaml
kms_proxy:
  mode: byo
  unwrap_endpoint: https://proxy.redwood.example/unwrap
  tls: mutual
  rotation:
    decryption_key_rotation_days: 1
    overlap_hours: 2
```

micah_engops: Also note failover behavior: if proxy unavailable we can serve from cached DEK for up to 5 minutes, beyond that key ops fail — recommend client side canary + circuit-breaker so your UX degrades gracefully. We can also set longer cache windows for read-heavy workloads (configurable).

Joe_Cust: Ok — can we get SOW + numbers + completed security questionnaire by tomorrow? This is gating our legal signature.

sarah_ae: On it — will DM you for contacts and confirm timeline. looping @micah_engops for the final latency test plan.

raj_se: I'll schedule a 20-min call tomorrow 10am PT to walk through HSM handshake, net tests, and demo a sample unwrap latency trace. :calendar:
